namespaces.prefix: StorageSettings.key_prefix (default dev), local ./data/files or S3 bucket

object_storage.note: Local path or S3/OSS bucket selected by config; prefixes below are the logical namespaces.

function_mediated_access.note: Table access performed inside SQL function bodies, statement by statement. Append-only stores such as assistant_runtime_items are written only through these functions; their rows therefore show no Python writer. Grants for these tables must follow the function ownership (ARC-03 SECURITY DEFINER rules).

role_model.current: All application services share one PostgreSQL user with a wide search_path; schemas are named apart but data privileges are not separated (PRD §1).
role_model.target: ARC-03 per-service roles (ai_gateway_gateway/runtime/capability_worker/knowledge_api/knowledge_worker) generated from this inventory.

purpose: Input for ARC-03 least-privilege grants and ARC-04 persistence owner separation. Static writer/reader attribution is a heuristic over SQL string literals; verify against runtime queries before narrowing any grant.

namespaces.namespace: agent memory vector collections (dynamic names from cleanup metadata vector_collections)

qdrant.target: ARC-00/ARC-03: every collection/alias/prefix gets exactly one owner plus a negative-deletion test; cross-namespace reads/writes need a named API/function.

redis.note: Cache/counter only; no durable system of record lives in Redis.
